title: 2022: one action generates the whole theory with its consistency established

statements.text: A single action over a constrained temporal flow field, a temporal differential inertia tensor, an informational resistance scalar, gauge and matter fields generates the full field equations, with dimensional consistency, covariant conservation, hyperbolicity and energy positivity established.

sources.quote: A single action generates the full Euler–Lagrange system. Dimensional consistency, covariant conservation, hyperbolicity under stated conditions, and energy positivity are established.
